up: List the distinct compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5303711. Include the compound's ChEMBL identifier and its preferred name (pref_name) where available. The compounds should be linked to the document via compound_records.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5303711';
